# FileSaver.js 2.0.5

The local minified script is an unchanged copy of the pinned 2.0.5 dependency
already used by this application and its real-browser regression runners.

- Upstream: https://github.com/eligrey/FileSaver.js
- Original script: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/FileSaver.js/2.0.5/FileSaver.min.js
- License: file-saver-2.0.5.LICENSE.md, copied from https://unpkg.com/file-saver@2.0.5/LICENSE.md

Keeping this dependency local removes a blocking external request during
workbench startup. No third-party version or download behavior was changed.
